TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings an integrated “network + civil works + security-by-design” delivery model aligned to CDA’s Safe-City CCTV and Command & Control Centre scope, combining infrastructure execution with governed information security and programme controls. We are SECP incorporated, tax-registered (ATL), and operate from Islamabad (HQ) with additional offices in Lahore and Karachi, enabling on-ground coordination and sustained support for city-wide deployments [CO-PROFILE].

For the command-and-control data environment, we hold ISO 27001, directly supporting the RFP’s mandatory information security requirement [CO-PROFILE]. We also evidence delivery across federal/provincial government and international clients, including cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure programmes, demonstrating capability to integrate complex digital platforms and operate under public-sector assurance expectations [CAP-049][CAP-024][CO-PROFILE]. For civil and right-of-way realities, we have executed road construction and bridge engineering projects, providing practical experience in planning, sequencing, and site controls for linear infrastructure and associated works [CAP-003][CAP-027][CAP-028].

Our differentiators for CDA are:
1) Governed delivery: PMP-certified project managers and CMMI Level 3 process maturity evidenced on delivered engagements [CO-PROFILE][CAP-009].
2) Secure operations readiness: ISO 27001-backed controls for the command centre and data systems [CO-PROFILE][CAP-001].
3) Safety discipline on live sites: documented HSE policy and site safety plans across infrastructure deployments [CO-PROFILE].

We will be transparent on mandatory eligibility: our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration (C-B or higher), ISO 14001 certification, PKR 2,500M average turnover (our evidenced average is PKR 900M), a PKR 1,500M+ safe-city project as prime, or assured access to trenching/boring/pole plant within 50 km of Islamabad [CO-PROFILE]. We will address these via a compliant civil-works JV/consortium partner and committed equipment access agreements, while TechnoCore leads the secure network/command-centre integration under ISO 27001 governance [CO-PROFILE].
